what_was_done: Read lab/TASKS.md, tasks/constraints/spec.md and dev.json; wrote one Python generator script (kept in the session scratchpad, outside the repo) that builds all 21 single-mode tasks and writes them as one JSON array.
answer_verification: Every reference answer is computed in Python from the same source data that is interpolated into the prompt (str.upper/lower/title/replace, join, slicing, len, datetime.strftime/isoformat, dict abbreviation map); none is hand-typed. Each check is one anchored case-sensitive regex built with re.escape from the computed answer (flags '' for one-line answers, 's' plus a line_count check for multi-line answers, with \s*\n\s* between lines). The script asserts that the reference matches, the near-miss negative does not, and that a variant with trailing double spaces and surrounding blank lines still matches.
not_done: No pilot against the model (held-out by instruction), so the easy/medium/hard labels are estimates from the family spec's difficulty guidance, not measured pass rates. Other generators' files were not read, so cross-generator overlap was not checked.
notes: Each task carries tags.derivation naming the Python operation used for its answer. No sorting, filtering or JSON output is required by any task.
